source: Norman 2020, Zoological Journal of the Linnean Society 191, Fig. 24: a simplified cladogram of the main dinosaur groups whose tips are clade names, not taxa; vertical, root at the bottom, thick lines, tip names written vertically with stacked letters, short bars on stems with clade names beside them and a bar pair joined by the label 'no gastralia'. Image: census 2 figure (555x470 px), the embedded raster.

gold_note: Cladogram of five higher taxa, read by eye; the tips are clade names. Sauropodomorpha, Ornithoscelida and Dinosauria, printed beside bars on the stems of their nodes, are kept as internal labels; 'no gastralia' marks a character shared by the Sauropoda and Ornithischia stems and is not a clade. Fully resolved. 5 tips, fully resolved; 3 printed clade names kept as internal node labels. Sample 7 case (census 2, seed 20261241).
